objective: Use the frozen M65/M69 drain and gate states to decompose the Poisson mismatch into dielectric-flux, electron-charge, hole-charge, and dopant-charge terms, then test whether material-local dielectric coupling and semiconductor-only barycentric or signed-AverageBox charge measures explain the residual high-NWell pair growth.

upstream.sentaurus_state_exports: M69 T-2022.03-SP2 drain and gate TDR exports

operators.legacy_all_cell: Production average-permittivity edge coupling and all-adjacent-cell barycentric charge measure.
operators.region_local_all_cell: Region-local permittivity edge coupling with the production all-cell charge measure.
operators.legacy_signed_si: Production dielectric coupling with semiconductor-only signed AverageBox charge measure.
operators.region_local_barycentric_si: Region-local dielectric coupling with semiconductor-only barycentric charge measure.
operators.region_local_signed_si: Region-local dielectric coupling with semiconductor-only signed AverageBox charge measure.

analysis.state_residual: Apply each frozen-state Poisson operator to the Sentaurus potential and Sentaurus region-0 carrier densities with the frozen Vela doping field.
analysis.linear_response: Solve A_free,free delta_psi=-residual_free with zero correction on all contact nodes.
analysis.control_node: Use the M69 gate-stage Sentaurus source-interface control node for both drain and gate stages of a case.
analysis.pair_proxy_dex: ((gate-drain correction at high NWell)-(gate-drain correction at low NWell))/(Vt*ln(10)).
targets: M65 matched-ni electrostatic barrier pair proxy

interpretation_guards: A frozen linear Poisson response is an attribution diagnostic, not a self-consistent current prediction.
Signed AverageBox and region-local variants remain diagnostic unless a later full-matrix self-consistent task qualifies one.
Large individual dielectric and charge responses may cancel; classification uses their summed response and the eight paired controls.
